name: 同じ著者の本と試聴と再生
prompt:
Create one Japanese catalog candidate for LH05-0172. Image 1 is the exact current Japanese component and is the authority for canvas size, layout, copy, and artwork; image 2 is the original ElevenReader screen and source-art reference. Preserve the compact 390×220 component: heading “同じ著者の本”, the existing book-cover image, the title “社会の目のもとで愛すること”, and exactly two actions “試聴する” and “再生する”. Keep the existing Meiryo roles and dimensions: heading Bold 20px/28px; book title Regular 14px/24px; action labels Regular 14px/24px. Keep the cover image intact; do not repaint its lettering or artwork. Preserve the existing positions and button sizes.
Apply the current Lighthouse design guidance: pure white canvas and surfaces, neutral borders, no mint wash or tinted surface. Make the secondary “試聴する” action a white button with a restrained neutral-gray border and dark text. Make the primary “再生する” action the only gradient surface, using exactly linear-gradient(135deg, #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%) with white text. Keep all other content neutral and the contrast readable. Do not add descriptions, icons, author labels, cards, or decorative effects that are absent from image 1. Do not alter, crop, or redraw the book-cover artwork. Output the same compact aspect ratio as image 1.
reviewNotes: Japanese content and source cover are visually retained; current forest gradient on primary play action and white neutral secondary surface. Exact cover pixels and native editability are not claimed.
